title: EXP-104 - Isolation Probe: Throwaway Flex Form FX_FlexProbe01 (Flex > Basic, No Collections) - Does Selecting Its FlexLayout Raise the Server-Event Error Seen on FX_CustomerPortal?
objective: Isolate the EXP-103 blocker: on FX_CustomerPortal, selecting flexlayoutPane_FX_CustomerPortal raises 'The server event processing returned an error' and Edit FlexLayout Attributes opens empty. Create one throwaway User-scope Flex Form FX_FlexProbe01 through New Form Definition > Flex > Basic exactly as in EXP-102 (Unit Char, Save Template unchecked) but with no collections and no Regenerate, then select its automatically created FlexLayout once and open Edit FlexLayout Attributes once, read-only, and record whether the error appears and whether the Properties grid and the dialog (attributes, region rows) are populated. Change nothing after Finish. Findings are observed only.

Create or update only experiments/EXP-104-flex-layout-selection-isolation-probe.md and evidence/EXP-104/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Gate (T1, read-only except one close): User scope; record which Form is open and that nothing is dirty (Save disabled) and whether an Error dialog is open (answer OK once if so and record it). If FX_CustomerPortal is open and clean, close it once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text) so that no Form is open. Record whether the Form menu recent-forms list contains FX_FlexProbe01 (read only; do not open it). Do not create anything in T1.

Create (T2): New Form Definition once, New Form, Category Flex, Wizard Basic, OK once. Name FX_FlexProbe01 (one plain fill; at most one correction), Unit Char (open the list and click the option), Comments blank; Next once; Save Template left unchecked (if it is checked, uncheck it and record it); Finish once; answer the 'Process Completed Successfully' message with OK. If the wizard reports that the name already exists or any error, record it verbatim and stop blocked. Verify FX_FlexProbe01 is open in User scope and clean, and record its Properties and Details > Components tree.

Probe (T2, read-only): do not touch Details > Collections and do not Regenerate. Select the FlexLayout once by a click on its row in Details > Components. Record immediately, with a screenshot, whether an Error dialog appears (verbatim text), what the Properties dropdown names and whether the Properties grid shows attributes. If an Error dialog appears, answer OK once. Then click the canvas Edit FlexLayout Attributes control once (the first small FlexLayout icon at the top left of the canvas; hover first to confirm its tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes'). Record whether an error appears (answer OK once) and whether the FlexLayout dialog shows any Attributes fields, region rows (Index, ID, Length) and Properties. If populated, select each region row once to view it and record its values; open no option list; change nothing. Leave the dialog with Cancel once and verify Save is still disabled. Finally record the Designer state with FX_FlexProbe01 left open and clean.

Capture screenshots of the gate, the close of FX_CustomerPortal, every wizard page, the completion message, the new Form with its Components tree, the moment after the FlexLayout selection, the tooltip, the dialog, each region row if populated, and the final state. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. Classify findings as observed only.

notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-103 was closed as blocked (operator decision 2026-10-16: 'Close blocked + probe'). Question: does selecting the FlexLayout of a fresh Flex > Basic Form without collections and without Regenerate raise the same server-event error and empty attributes dialog as FX_CustomerPortal? If not, the cause is likely FX_CustomerPortal's collections or Regenerate (EXP-102); if yes, it is wider (for example the FX_HelloWorld theme's FlexLayout class FX_BlueBackground from EXP-100, or the product build). FX_FlexProbe01 is a factory-owned User-scope test Form recorded for later cleanup.
